extraction_notes: Extracted experimental CO2 hydrogenation performance from Tables 4, 5 and 6. Adsorption-only experiments (Table 3) and dynamic/model-predicted pressure results (Fig. 16) were not output as catalyst-performance records. Figures 7, 8, 11 and 13 duplicate tabulated values and were not separately digitized. The schema has no fields for CH3OH/CO yields or sorption-enhancement contribution, so those printed values are preserved in record notes.
